report.answer: On Sunday 2024-07-28 there were 75,768 total trips with a 16% airport‑trip share (11,907 airport trips), versus Tuesday 2024-07-30 with 94,765 total trips and a 10% airport‑trip share (9,184 airport trips). The profiler‑verified baseline shows a -20.0% raw gap in total trips, but the airport‑trip share is 6 percentage points higher on Sunday, indicating that the drop in airport pickups is driven primarily by lower overall demand, not by a shift away from airport zones. Weather was identical on both days (0.0 mm precip, wmo_code 3), so the difference is not weather‑related.
